statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ b : ℕ, 2≤b → ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range b → 2≤D.card → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0<δ ∧ δ<1 ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, let S := (Finset.range (b^k)).filter (fun n : ℕ => ∀ i < k, (n/b^(i))%b ∈ D ∧ (n/b^(i))%b=(n/b^(k-1-i))%b); (((S).filter (fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n))).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(1+(S.card:ℝ))^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 对固定宽度回文数字盒，按回文族本身的大小证明幂节省。
plain_statement.en: Obtain a power saving relative to a palindromic digit box.

brief.zh: 镜像约束把远端两位绑定。全字母表定理在平方根规模的回文子族上可能给不出界；从镜像权重 bⁱ+bᵏ⁻¹⁻ⁱ 的乘积入手。
brief.en: Pair distant digit positions in the Fourier transform. Normalize by the mirror population itself, with leading zeroes allowed.
